cli: aggregate --metadata-root FROZEN_METADATA --raw-root VERIFIED_RAW --contract IMMUTABLE_METHOD_CONTRACT --permit IMMUTABLE_EXPLICIT_ROLE_PERMIT --output NEW_RUNTIME --roles TRAIN VALIDATION TRAIN_CONTROL_SOURCE_SCOPE --contexts HCT116 HEK293T

outputs.FULL_SUMS.npy: float64 condition-by-full-Ensembl, memmap; raw log-normalized cell sums
outputs.CELL_COUNTS.npy: uint64 per matrix row, equal retained cell denominator
outputs.FULL_MEANS.npy: float64 condition-by-full-Ensembl CP4000log1p cell equal mean
outputs.FULL_EFFECTS.npy: float64 FULL_MEANS minus matching own-context TRAIN NTC mean
outputs.ENDPOINT3285_MEANS.npy: float64 fixed Source3285 projection of full means
outputs.ENDPOINT3285_EFFECTS.npy: float64 fixed Source3285 projection of full effects
outputs.FULL_GENE_AXIS.csv: ordered contiguous gene_token_id, unique Ensembl; duplicated symbols remain on full axis
outputs.ENDPOINT_GENE_MANIFEST.csv: unchanged fixed exact Source3285 symbol/Ensembl/token mapping
outputs.TRAIN_MATRIX_ROWS.npy: int64 indexes for separate-context TRAIN fitting
outputs.VALIDATION_MATRIX_ROWS.npy: int64 authorized validation rows; never a PCA fitting role
outputs.TRAIN_CONTROL_SOURCE_SCOPE_MATRIX_ROWS.n: own-context control indexes; excludes exposed preview cells
outputs.BIOLOGY_MANIFEST.json: exact scientific contract/permit/code SHA, role mask/raw/md SHA perfile, decodertrace, resource use, semantic gates
outputs.ARTIFACT_HASHES.json: SHA256 and bytes for saved arrays, metadata, manifests

privacy: Numeric conversion only for exact allowed physical rows; TEST and DEV payloads stay opaque bytes. No complete cell dataframe or cell dense matrix.
row_order_binding: original_row_index sequential and original_row_group zero; row metadata SHA and publisher fullraw SHA checked before numeric decoder
staging_commit: Output path appears only after both numeric iterators fully exhaust all files and measured counts match metadata; failure keeps incomplete staging without COMPLETE manifest
raw_UMI_format: allallowed finite, nonnegative, nonempty and integer within absolute1e-6; TRAIN/NTC rawsum vs official total_counts atol/rtol1e-6; no count rounding or denominator change

resident_memory_plan.token_spool: bounded uint32 ragged disk spool removed after complete expression stream
resident_memory_plan.matrix_disk_limit_scope: 16GiB per fullcondition-by-gene float64matrix; threefullmatrices plus endpoints/counts on disk, memmaps do not imply full resident copies
